race.comment: A BIT DUSTY (4) did nit have much go his way here last time out over 2200m, and his form over this trip on wet ground prior was much better, including his maiden win in September 3 starts back. He has a better gate to use this time, and can make amends. EVADE THE GAME (8) has been mixing her form, and she seems to improve when the tracks are wet. Her only win came on this track over the trip, and she can bounce back into the money here. BOSSIRI (5) fought on well enough for third in a 6-horse field here just over 6 weeks ago, and she has another crack at 1800m. She is a top 4 hope in a modest field. ORMOND ROAD (11) has found it hard to win another race, but his form has been solid enough this season. Stick with him.
